abstract: This paper studies the design of two channel regular orthogonal principal component filter banks.A type of the parametric representation of the regular product filters is proposed,by which the optimal problem is transferred into a standard LSIP.And an efficient feasible solution iteration algorithm is given for the single and double parameter cases.

title: STUDY ON HEAT BEHAVIOR OF COAL TAR PITCH MODIFIED WITH DIVINYLBENZENE
abstract: We modified medium temperature coal tar pitch with divinylbenzene (DVB) in the presence of p toluene sulfonic (PTS). Differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) and simultaneous thermal analysis (TG, DTA) are employed to study on thermal behavior of the modified coal tar pitch. The results show that phase change of the modified coal tar pitch is different from that of parent coal tar pitch for their respective compositions change greatly. DSC curves show that the curing reaction of the modified coal tar pitch can be easily controlled, and apparent activation energy (E a) is 38.0?kJ/mol. Moreover, the modified coat tar pitch possessed good stability as indicated by that the weightlossness ratio is only 47.5?%. Therefore, it can be used for an excellent carbon precursor.

title: Discussion about Subsidy of Affordable Housing
abstract: Discussing the subsidy form of affordable housing,it is known that explicit subsidy, poll subsidy and periodical subsidy avoid a lot of problems. At the same level of subsidy, home-busyer will get more benefit from the explicit, poll and periodical subsidy than it from implicit, bricks and motar, and disposable subsidy. Also a model of housing subsidy is established, and some suggestion is given for the perfection of the subsidy supporting system.

title: The mass sensitivity analysis of a double-waveguide love wave sensor
abstract: The paper investigates love wave behavior and mass sensitivity in a doublewaveguide Love wave sensor.Firstly,general mechanical displacement and a dispersion equation are derived by solving elastic field equations with continuity boundary condition. Then the mass sensitivity is obtained by combing perturbation theory.An analysis of ST- 90°X/SiO_2/Gold structure Love wave sensor is presented.The properties of love wave phase velocity and mass sensitivity are calculated when the thickness of waveguide layers change.The theoretical results show that phase velocity decreases and the number of modes increases as the thickness of the waveguide increases.Furthermore,the sensor can achieve the largest mass sensitivity with a particular waveguide thickness by controlling the thickness of the waveguides.

title: Tumor Suppressor Gene p~(16) and Genetherapy of Cancer
abstract: The activation of oncogene and inactivation of tumor suppressor gene were known as oncogenesis molecular mechanism of cellular cancerization.Of the known tumor suppressor gene,p 16 is as important as p53 and RB.In this review,we have summarized the structure,dysfunction and relevant gengetherapy of p 16.

title: Corrosion Mechanism of Pulse Plated Nickel Deposit on Depleted Uranium Surface
abstract: Corrosion mechanism of nickel deposit on depleted uranium surface prepared by pulse plating was studied by scanning electron microscope (SEM), X-ray energy dispersion spectroscope (EDS) and electrochemical technology. The results indicate that in potassium chloride solution with 50 μg/g Cl~(-), the corrosion of nickel deposit on uranium surface occurs at it's pit and extends to the interface between uranium and nickel deposit. The (accumulation ) of corrosion product results in the cracking of nickel deposit. Because nickel is a cathodic coating for the uranium matrix, the galvanic corrosion will happen when they contact. The protection of nickel coating to uranium depends on the physical barrier of nickel coating to the corrosive medium. The densification of the nickel coating will (improve ) the corrosion resistant performance of nickel coating to uranium.

title: High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein and Atherosclerosis
abstract: Aim Measurable C-reactive protein using high sensitive method was so called high-sensitivity C-reactive protein.C-reactive protein plays an increasingly important role in the diagnosis and prediction of coronary heart disease and peripheral vascular disease according to a number of researches,more and more studies have revealed C-reactive protein directly involved in cardiovascular diseases,such as inflammation and atherosclerosis.Furthermore,it is one of the most powerful predictors of cardiovascular disease risk factors.All kinds of inflammation,tissue infection and damage will increase the levels of several plasma proteins in circulation,including C-reactive protein as an acute phase reactive protein,and its increased level is a sensitive indicator of inflammation in vivo.As it's known,inflammation plays an important role in the development and progression of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease.The relationship and mechanism between hs-CRP and atherosclerosis will be described in this article.

title: On Using Communicative Approach in the Teaching of Commercial English Writing
abstract: This paper attempts to probe into the characteristics of the Course of Commercial English writing and give a theoretical analysis to its particularities in the light of the author's teaching experience. In accordance with the fact that written form communication is the core of this course, the guiding principles in using communicative approach should be as follows: 1 .The training of communicative skills should be focused on professional level of commercial activities. 2. Communicative competence should be integrated with the aims, the strategy and the tactics of commercial activities. In teaching method, the author also puts forward some referential suggestions which come from practice .

title: Influence of GBV-C/HGV on the etiology of acute non A～E hepatitis
abstract: To investigate the role of GB virus C/hepatitis G virus(GBV-C/HGV) on the etiology of acute non A~E hepatitis.Liver biopsy from 56 patients with acute non A~E hepatitis were detected for GBV-C/HGV non-structure 5 antigen(NS5 Ag) by immunohistochemistry.The pathological results and the clinical data were analyzed.In acute non A~E hepatitis,the total positive rate of GBV-C/HGV NS5 Ag in liver tissues was 53.6%.The majority were coinfected with HBV or HCV.The liver function test(ALT) in acute hepatitis B or C was similar in patients coinfected and in those not coinfected with GBV-C/HGV.Only 16.1% were infected with GBV-C/HGV alone.The ALT were significantly lower in the patients with GBV-C/HGV infected alone than those with HBV or HCV co infected,but similar to those in acute hepatitis of unknown etiology.The pathogenicity of GBV-C/HGV is doubtful.GBV-C/HGV may not be one of the main pathogenic agents of acute hepatitis.

title: Phase Shifter Materials with Zn Ti Sn-subtituted Lithium Ferrites
abstract: For Studying higy-property phase shifter materials in a phase axray antenna of autotrack synchronous communication satellites, lithium ferrite Li0.625Zn0.1Ti0.25Sn0.1Fe1.925O4 was prepared by using a standard ceramic flowing oxygen sifitering technique and adding some benificial materials such as MnCO3, Bi2O3 etc. The microwave properties of ferrite phase shifter materlals Li0.5(1-y)ZnyFe2.5(1-0.2,)O4 were discussed. The measured results show that lithium ferrite Li0.625Zn0.1Ti0.25Sn0.1Fe1.925O4 possesses high Curie temperature and low dielectric loss.

title: A New Micropayment Scheme Based on Scrip
abstract: This paper proposes a new efficient micropayment scheme based on scrip,where a merchant can authorize the broker via licensed scrip production to produce vendor scrip the vendor validates and accepts on-line during payment. Moreover, all the information with regard to payment is encrypted using a shared symmetric key,which improves the security standard of our scheme and it can prevent the consumer from double spending because the identifier of the scrip is unique. Compared with other micropayment schemes in existence ,no public-key operation is required and the information stored is very simple, which minimizes the computation and storage overhead dramatically. In addition,our scheme supports divisibility and transferability of digital coins in a simpler way.

title: High fill subgrade of express highway improved by vacuum preloading method
abstract: The soft subgrade with high fill of an express highway is improved by vacuum preloading method, Field observation results indicate that the improving effect is evident. Compared with the preloading method, the construction time of the vacuum preloading method is short, the strength of the subgrade soil increases quickly, the settlement of the subgrade is small and the embankment is stable.

title: Application of adding-weight zero-rank local-region method on prediction of public opinion on the Internet
abstract: To forecast public opinion trend on the Internet, many notes were collected from a famous website's BBS, which came forth in a period of time. A time series of the number of new notes was built according to time cycle. Then the series' change and trend were predicted by the adding-weight zero-rank local-region method in chaotic time series prediction method. The simulation result indicated that the prediction number was consistent with the fact number in short term, and the short-term prediction error was obviously smaller than the long-term error.

title: Clinical practice of the work amount machine of treadmill of the Modle EGM-III
abstract: Purpose:Observe the value of diagnosing the coronary heart disease of work amount machine of treadmill of Model EGM-Ⅲ that the medical instrument and equipment factory,the first hospital of Beijing Univetsity of yueyang jointly develop.Modle:Adopt the movement esperiment FOX scheme of treadmill.Result:Observe 248,dropand rise and greater than or equal 1mv by section with ST,sport appear angina pectoris,rhythm of the heart the positive standard.Obserne T wave it changes to be can as positivereference standard of patient,R wave it drops to be can′t as positive reference standardof patient,Blood pressure level can′t as positive diagnostio standard of patient,therhythm of the heart car only be regarded as and stop the experiment standard.

title: Investigations of the Molecule-Structure-Factors Influences on the First Hyperpolarizabilities of the Organic Molecules
abstract: The molecule-structure-factors influences, including the positive/negative charge influence, the conjugated π-electron number influence, the conjugated π-atom influence, the linking influence and the donor/acceptor influence, on the β-values have been studied. The molecule transition energy ν_a has been firstly introduced to link the above five influences. A linear function group and a net-like graph for describing the linear relationship between the β-values and ν_a have been obtained containing all of five influences, from which one could find the key factor to influence on the β-values and obtain desired maximum β-value for each influence. So the graph gives out a new idea and opens a new way to design and synthesize new organic molecules with high β-values.

title: Determination of molecular weight of hyroxyethl starch 200/0.5 injection by HPGPC
abstract: OBJECTIVE To develop an HPGPC method for the determination of molecular weight and distribution of hyroxyethl starch 200 /0.5 injection.METHODS The method was carried out on Ultrohydrogel 1000 ( 300 mm × 7.8 m,10 μm) with CH3COOH/CH3COONa as a mobile phase.RESULTS Molecular weight was between 1.9 × 105 and 2.9 × 105.CONCLUSION The method established was simple,accurate.

title: Technology Produces the WAP Page Based on PHP
abstract: PHP technology is an effective tool to develop dynamic web application procedure.Firstly,the papers analyzed the flaw of traditional web development technology.Then introduced the characteristics,work principle and realization method of PHP technology.Based on these,the article introduced some page example utilizing PHP to realize WAP (Wire Application Protocol).It has been proved through practical application that the dynamic WML page through WAP server language utilizing PHP technology has wide application value and commercial value.

title: A PAIR OF VICARIOUS SPECIES OF HIPPEOPHYLLUM: H.SINICUM(sp. nov.) FROM GANSU AND H.PUMILUM FROM TAIWAN
abstract: Hippeophyllum sinicum sp.nov.is described and illustrated;nomenclatural issues of H.pumilum are discussed and its lectotype is designated.

title: Correlation Between Cardio-Ankle Vascular Index and Coronary Artery Disease
abstract: Aim To investigate the prognostic value of cardio-ankle vascular index(CAVI) in the occurrence of coronary heart disease(CHD).Methods 497 patients treated with coronary angiography were studied.All patients underwent cardio-ankle vascular index(CAVI) and serum factors evaluation in addition to history collection.The severity of coronary artery stenosis was evaluated by the number of diseased arteries and Gensini score.The risk factors of coronary heart disease and CAVI were compared between each group.The predicting role of these variables,especially CAVI,to the occurrence of CHD was analysed with Logistic regression.Results There were significant differences in sex composition,age,hypertension,diabetics,hyperlipidemia and cigarette smoking between the CHD group and the non-CHD group(P0.05).The CAVI were significantly higher in patients with coronary artery disease than in the normal subjects(P0.05).There was a positive linear trend between CAVI and Gensini's score(r=0.763,P0.01). Multiple logistic analysis indicated that age,hypertension,diabetics,hyperlipidemia,cigarette smoking and CAVI were significantly correlated to the occurence of CHD(P0.05).Conclusion Just like age,hypertension,diabetics,hyperlipidemia and cigarette smoking,CAVI were also independent risk factors of CHD.CAVI was an unattached predictor of the severity of coronary artery stenosis.

title: Influence of Process Optimization on Working Efficiency of Neurosurgery Operation Room
abstract: Objective To study the influence of process optimization on efficiency of neurosurgery operation room.Methods Measures of process optimization including appropriate application of resources in operation room,identification of critical time point,establishing an operation supply support team,cards with doctors' preference were developed and their influence on the efficiency of operation room was evaluated.Results Punctuality rate of skin incision was improved from 45.3% to 86.5% and the convergence time for the surgery was shortened about 8 min to 11 min.Average operations for nurses increased from 100.05 to 114.29 and mean time for operation cooperation everyday decreased from 615.5 min to 585.5 min.Both doctors and patients were more satisfied with the operation.Conclusion Measures in process optimization benefits the improvement of efficiency in operation room.

title: Effect on D1-Like and D2-Like agonist on GABA_A-receptor in rat dorsal root ganglion
abstract: The experiment was performed on neurons freshly isolated from rat DRG by using whole cell patch clamp techniques When 60 cells responded to GABA were treated with SKF38393, a selective agonist of dopamine Dl receptor, it was found that except one cell which exhibited a slight potentiation( l0 0%,l/60), the inhibition by SKF38393 of GABA activated current was predominant (88 33%,53/60), while the remainders were of no effect( l 66%,6/60) In 50 neurons tested , when the neurons were treated with R(-) NPA prior to the application of GABA for 30sec, It was found that GABA activated membrane currents were inhibited (76%,38/50) , enhanced (2%,l/50) , no effected markedly (22%,11/50) The effect of SKF38393 and R(-) NPA was dependent on the concentration of SKF38393 and R(-) NPA By intracellular application of 10 -4 mol/L H7, a potent inhibitor of protein kinase , via micropipette the inhibition of SKF38393 and R(-) NPA was abolished apparently as compared with the control

title: A Method for Separation of Glucose Oxidase
abstract: A method for separation of glucose oxidase(GOD) has been developed. A chroma tographic column is filled with an anion exchanger of styrene divinyl benzene matrix conta ining quaternary ammonium salt. The buffered phosphate and acetate solutions were used as eluents. Two GOD components(GOD A and GOD B) were separated by this method. Their enzyme activity and ζ potential values were 86 9, 27 3, and -4 3 mV, -6 4 mV, respecti vely . The simplicity and low cost of the method make it valuable for practical applications.

title: Clinical investigation of LDH,Albumin and Uric acid in predicting the outcome of early onset severe Pre-eclampsia
abstract: Objective Pre-eclampsia is a specific disease of pregnancy with multisystem complications.We conducted this study to examine the relationship between albumin,lactic dehydrogenase,uric acid concentration and the severity of the disease and the occurrence of its complications.Methods 78 PE cases with monofetus were chosen as subjects excluding any physical diseases which could influence the conclusion.78 cases were grouped 34 with and 44 without symptoms,48 with and 30 without complications and 30 with and 48 without perinatal mortality.Results Pregnant women with complications had low level albumin and high level uric acid(P0.01);Pregnant women with symptoms had high level LDH(P0.01);Pregnant women with perinatal mortality had low level albumin,high level uric acid and LDH(P0.01).Conclusion LDH,albumin,uric acid can predict the severity of early onset severe pre-eclampsia.

title: Comment on Middle school Sports Teaching Methods Research
abstract: After sorting and analyzing the related studies on Chinese middle school sports teaching methods, this article finds that the present study of middle school sports teaching methods focus on sports teaching methods, teaching materials about teaching methods, teaching method innovation, reform and evaluation of physical education teaching methods. The research content is relatively rich, but the density is not meticulous enough, which needs to be broaden the research thinking in the future and continual study.

title: Initiative education in universities
abstract: BZ: At the16th conference of the Party,Jiang Zemin restates that we must adhere to initiative education and educate initiative talents,which is the needs of China's entering WTO and significant countermeasure for meeting the challenge of science and technology.In order to make Chinese universities and colleges suuessfal,we must renew our educational concepts,develop teaching democracy,create favorable teaching environment,make a rich initiative atmosphere and standardize the criterion of talents.

title: Study on Application of Yellow Water and Ending Water of Luzhou-flavor Liquor in New Craft Liquor Production
abstract: Yellow water, the by-product in the fermentation of Luzhou-flavor liquor, is brown yellow sticky liquid and contains abundant flavoring materials including acids, esters, alcohols, aldehydes and clostridia. Practically, it could be applied in the blending of low-grade new type liquor after decoloration management and in the preparation of esterifying liquid which then used in the production of high-grade new type liquor after distillation or cross steaming management; Ending water was used as the substitute for seriflux in the blending of low-grade liquor; Ending water and yellow water managed and mixed by the ratio of 1∶1 could be applied in blending of low-grade new craft liquor; And ending water and yellow water managed and stored for two years could be used as flavoring liquor.(Tran.by YUE Yang)

title: Synthesis of Composite AIN Powder Mixed with Sintering Additives by the Lanxide Method
abstract: Composite AlN powder, mixed with the sintering additive Y2O3, was synthesized by the direct nitridation of molten Al-Mg-Y alloys. The character of products was determined by means of electron microscopy, X-ray diffraction, granularmetric analysis and chemical composition analysis etc. The results show that the nitridation rate of the raw alloys is higher, and the nitridation products axe porous enough to be easily crushed. Composite AlN powder, obtained by the Lanxide method, has excellent characters such as high purity, especially low oxygen content, and narrow well-distributed grain size and so on.

title: Technical Summary of Multiple-layer Pit Mud Fermentation in Improving the Quality of Luzhou-flavor Daqu Liquor
abstract: The utilization of multiple layer pit mud fermentation in improving the quality of Luzhou-flavor daqu liquor could enhance the quality rate from original 31.1 % to 40.8 % and the quality rate will reach above 55 % four years later with the precondition of no drop of liquor yield. Meanwhile, the degradation of multiple layer mud was analyzed and relative methods to settle the problem were put forward to assure favorable practice of the technique.(Tran.by YUE Yang)

title: Decision Analysis of Firm Initial Public Ofering
abstract: It is an important issue for firm to determinate the IPO decision. The effect of strategy investor in new issue market is discussed in the paper. The number of shares between strategy investor and public investor is calculated. The Nash equilibrium of firm and strategy investor is showed in paper.

title: ZnTi-Substituted Hexaferrite BaFe_(12)O_(19)
abstract: Magnetic anisotropic Polycrystalline Ba(ZnTi)x.Fe12-2x.O19 hexaferrites have been prepared with high orientation degrees f and low dielectric loss tgδe by standard ceramic techniques with magnetic alignment of the grains c axes during wet pressing and in flowing oxygen sintering. When x increases, the saturation magnetization M,, the Curie temperature 7. and the anisotropy field H. of Ba(ZnTi).Fe12-2xO19. hexaferrites decrease. The results can be interpreted by assuming that Zn2+ ions replaces Fe3+ ions of the tetrahedral 4f1 sites and hexahedral 2b sites.Ti4+ ions replaces spin up re+ ious of octahedral sublattices 12k and 2a.

title: DETECTION OF TWO-DIMENSIONAL OBJECTS IN HALF SPACE
abstract: The detection of shallow two - dimensional objects in layered media by using time domain scattering data is considered in this paper. A volumn integral equation which relates the scattering fields in time domain with the permittivity of the objects is obtained by volumn equivalence principle. The equation is transfered into frequency domain and the inversion equation is obtained after discretion. With our iterative method both forward and inverse problems are solved in each iteration. The forward problem is solved by using finite-difference time - domian method. The inverse problem is carried out by using a pseudoinverse technique. The Green function excited by line current source is derived by using plane wave expansion method. Several examples are given to show the ability of this metohd to invert arbitrarily shaped objects.

title: The Construction of Internationalized Cities and The Modernization of Youth Quality
abstract: Upon on the target of internationalized cities of Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou, for the intemational functioning of center city, culture city and landscape city, new demands has been put on the youth quality. The emphases of the modernization of youth quality are on three facets, which are the cultur-ing of citizenship, the exploitation of innovation and the enhancement of culture qualites.

title: Effects of Two Kinds Miling Processing on Nutritional and Functional Components of Purple Wheat
abstract: wheat flour and bran were gain by the two processed methods of mechanical and stone milling,and then were system analyzed and compared for their starch,protein,fat,fiber,vitamins,minerals,amino acids,total phenols,anthocyanins and other nutritional components.Results showed that layer debranning and stone milling had significant difference on nutritional and functional components of flour and bran(P0.05).The contents of conventional nutrients,calcium,iron,zinc and vitamin in first-class wheat flour and mechanical bran were higher than the flour and bran of stone milling,whereas the contents of selenium in stone flour was higher 113.90 % than first-class flour,the retention of anthocyanin in stone milling was higher 4.90 % higher than mechanical milling.All of above indicated that different processing method has different advantages and disadvantages.Addictively,from the results of amino acid composition, Purple wheat was superior to common wheat(AAS scores were higher 9.70 % than common wheat),the lysine score of wheat bran was more than 1(amino acids changed into non-restricted),and the anthocyanin content up to 2 904.93 mg/kg,which suggested that the bran of Purple 4 wheat was a high-quality material for bran into flour in whole wheat processing.

title: Human Factor Analysis of Software Interface of CNC Machine Tool
abstract: It is important to design user software interface of CNC machine tool with considering of human factors. This paper analyzes user software interface of CNC 500 V200 Milling from human information process,user’operation and menu semantic system’s point of view,puts forward the existing problems and proposes methods to solve the problems.

title: CHARACTERISTICS AND EVOLUTION OF ORDOVICIAN CARBONATE ROCK BED OF OIL-GAS CONDENSATE RESERVOIR IN QIANMIQIAO BURIED HILL
abstract: Ordovician carbonate rock bed of Ordovician reservoir in Qianmiqiao buried hill experienced two times of karst exposure and the post plaeogene deep-buried diagenesis.The first is the depression karst development pattern from dissolution of karst hill during Indo-Chinese epoch which is the key period for forming space of the reservoir.Analysis of six cementing events indicates that the deeply buried karst during Himalayan epoch is related to corrosive hydrothermal fluid and is the key period for forming porous system of the present reservoir.The limited hydrothermal karst and mixed zone beneath the anticline axis controls the porosity distribution of Ordovician System and it is anticipated that surroundings of the axis of fold formed by compressional reverse orverthrusting during Indo-Chinese epoch and the coordinated area of morphology of anticline in the screen of buried hill and that of top surface morphology is the best position for development of the reservoir.

title: APPLICATION OF PEROXIDASE ISOZYMES TO IDENTIFICATION F1 HYBRIDS OF CAMELLIA
abstract: In this paper 12 F1 hybrids of four combinations were compared with their parents in morphology and peroxidase isozymes, the results indicated that: (1) Certain morphological characters may be used for initial identification of Fl hybrids. (2) Nine of all hybrids display both parental bands except one peculiar band of C. chrysantha, and possess hybrid - bands not observed in either parent; zymograms of the two other plants are the same as female parents, possibly not true hybrids. (3) The Fl hybrids produced from C. chrysantha, C. reticulata or C. pitardii var. yunnanica express various zymograms. Based on the above, we propose that it is a much effective method to identify F1 hybrids by using peroxidase isozyme variations.

title: Relationship between self-efficacy and mental health in recruits of armed police forces
abstract: Objective To investigate the relationship between selfefficacy and mental health in recruits of armed police forces.Methods At the end of 2005,1941 male recruits of armed police forces were measured for self-efficacy using General Self-Efficacy Scale(GSES) and mental health using Symptom Distress Checklist-90(SCL-90).Results The component scores and total scores of GSES and SCL-90 in male recruits all showed statistically negative correlation by two-tailed test;the component and total scores of SCL-90 in high self efficacy group were lower than those in low self-efficacy group,with significant differences(P0.05).Conclusions The recruit's mental health may be improved by increase in their self-efficacy.

title: Solvents Effects on Molecular First - Hyperpolarizabilities of Stilbazolium - like Dyes
abstract: We have proved that the first - hyperpolarizabilities (βxxx) of the four stilbazolium - like dyes, which are trans - (N - methylpyrrol -2-yl) - 4 - (N - methyl - pyridinio) - stilbazolium iodide ( MPPSI) , trans - (pyrrol -2-yl) - 4 - (N - methyl - pyridinio) - stilbazolium iodide (PPSI) , trans - (furan - 2 -yl) - 4 - (TV - methyl - pyridinio) - stilbazolium iodide (FPSI) and trans - (thiophene -2-yl) - 4- (N -methyl- pyridinio) - stilbazolium iodide (TPSI), can be linearly correlated with the electron excessivities ofdonors in fifteen solvents. Then we obtained the linearity correlation between the βxxx of the dyes and thesolvents polarity [ET(30) ]. From the two linearity correlations we obtain three solvent factors η, δA and δD fordescribing the solvents effects on the βxxx: η describes the sensitivity of the intramolecular electron transfer tothe solvent polarity, δA and δD describe the accepting/donating ability of the acceptor/donor effected by thesolvent polarity respectively. The δA increases linearly, but the δD is decreased linearly with increasing of the ET(30).

title: Effect of Seedbed Soil Fertilizing for Mechanical Transplanting Rice Seedling
abstract: Seedbed soil fertilizing is one of the key measures for raising mechanical transplanting rice seedling.The relationship of fertilizing levels to the increase of available N,P,K in seedbed soil and their uptake during seedling growth were analyzed,using alluvial soil and hill-paddy field soil as seedbed soil,fertilizing the seedbed soil with 10-10-5 compound fertilizer,with Wuyujing 3 as material.The results showed that contents of available N,P,K were increased quickly by application of inorganic fertilizer.The increase of available N exhibited an exponent curve,and was higher under high level of fertilization than under low level,and was faster in hill soil thao in alluvial soil.Available P content was increased linearly with the increase of fertilizing level,there was significant difference between soil types,and the increased velocity in hill soil was more quickly than that in alluvial soil.The trend of increase in available K content was similar to that in P,but the difference of increased velocity between different types of soil was not significant.After the seedlings grew and consumed,the uptake of nutrients in seedlings was high under a higher fertilizing level of available N,P,K during raising.The available N in seedbed in all treatments was highly correlated with fertility level before fertilizing,indicating that the use of available N by seedling was affected by the fertility level of seedbed soil.The consumption of available P was increased linearly with the increase of the fertilizing levels,and significant difference was found among seedbed soil types.The consumption of available K was similar to that of available P,but it was consistent among different soil types.The seedling growth on various fertilizing levels was observed.The data showed that seedling height was increased while root/shoot ratio was reduced with the increase of the fertilizing level within a suitable range.From the above results,we can conclude that fertilizing the seedbed can increase available N,P,K contents rapidly,but the characteristics are different and closely related to the soil types.Only within the range of suitable fertilizing level,the strong seedlings with the suitable shape and root/shoot ratio for mechanical transplanting can be raised.

title: Study on apoptotic effect induced by isothiocyanates in broccoli on HepG-2
abstract: To investigate the apoptosis effect of isothiocyanates(ITCS) on human hepatoma cells HepG-2 and possible mechanism of it.HepG-2 cells were treated with different concentrations of ITCS.SRB assay was used to observe the inhibitory rate of ITCS,and fluorescence microscope,flow cytometry and laser confocal microscopy were used to observe the influence of ITCS on cell apoptosis and cell cycle changes of HepG-2.The results showed that the proliferation of HepG-2 cells was inhibited after treated with 1,10,50 and 150 μg/mL ITCS for 72 h and the IC_(50) is 15.824 μg/mL.After HepG-2 cells were treated by 120 μg/mL ITCS for 24 h,morphological changes of early apoptosis were observed.After treating with 60,120,240 μg/mL of ITCS for 48 h,the apoptotic rates of HepG-2 cells were(16.6±2.8)%,(21.9±4.4)% and(70.2±5.3)%separately,and the intracellular[Ca~(2+)]i level was remarkablly increased(P0.05).ITCS can induce HepG-2 cell apoptosis and the mechanism is that ITCS can increase the concentration of Ca~(2+)in HepG-2 cells.

title: Development and Use of Foreign Periodicals Resources in University Libraries
abstract: This paper expounds the importance of the foreign periodicals resources in bibliographic resources construction in university libraries, analyses problems in foreign periodicals resources construction and puts forward tactics and countermeasures to solve these problems.

title: Synthesis of A Novel Chiral Functional Monomer
abstract: A series of chiral molecular imprinted polymer were synthesized from(R)-acryloyl-1-naphthylethylamine(1,chiral functional monomer) which was obtained from aromatic amine and acrylamide.The structure of 1 was characterized by ~1H NMR,IR,MS and elemental analysis.

title: INFLUENCE OF DIFFERENT SOFTENING CURVES ON CRACK EXTENSION RESISTANCE CURVE G_R
abstract: Recently, the crack extension resistance curve for crack propagation was proposed based on the crack cohesive action, where energy dissipation due to aggregate cohesive action is the primary contribution. In addition, energy dissipation is closely related with the tension softening curve, i.e., cohesive stress-crack opening displacement curve. Recognizing this, the influences of softening curve on crack extension resistance GR are studied in this paper. Four different tension softening curves are examined firstly. The results show that crack extension resistance GR is sensitive to tension softening curve, and its feasibility depends on the accuracy of softening curve. Also, it is found that the characteristic points in crack extension resistance curve are corresponding to those on softening curve.

title: Application of TH-AADY in the Production of Alcohol
abstract: The experience of TH-AADY instead of self-cultured yeast in the production of alcohol in our Co.was introduced in this paper.The test results indicated that TH-AADY had the advantages of acid resistant ,high temperature resistant ,low fermentation acidity,low residual sugar,high alcoholicity and shortening the fermentation time etc.Its application would increase the utilization rate of production facilities so that the production costs could be reduced and the economical profits could be promoted as well.(Tran.by YUE Yang)

title: Study on parasitical characteristic of Neosentis celatus (acanthocephala) in Monopterus albus
abstract: The parasitical characteristic of Neosentis celatus (acanthocephala) in Monopterus albus was studied in this ex- periment with the ways of random sample and statistic,the results showed that infection rate of Neosentis celatus in Monoptrus albus was 27.2%,intensity of infection was 6.2,mean intensity was 1.67,the most worms was sixty-eight founded in one fish.Infection rate and intensity of infection changed with the body length of fishes,infection rate varied from 23.1% to 37.5%,and intensity of infection ranged from 4.8 to 8.8.Infection rate was maximal when the body length varied from 20 to 25 centimeter,and intensity of infection was the highest with the body length changing from 36 to 40 centimeter,but there was no difference between infection rate and intensity of infection ranging the body length,the rate of infecting six worms was the biggest.The worms were mainly parasite in forepart of intestine,and 65.3% worms distributed along forepart of intestine from zero to three centimeter.The distribution of the parasites in Monoptrus albus was collective.

title: An Analysis on Specification of Remote Sensing Satellite Transmission Channel Coding Adopting Reed-Solomon and Convolutional Coding
abstract: The paper analyzed the specification on remote sensing satellite channel coding adopting Reed Solomon coding and Convolutional coding.The paper also gives an introduction of Reed Solomon(255,223,interleaving is 4)coding,Convolutional coding(7,1/2)and(7,3/4),Randomization.Excellences when remote sensing satellite channel coding adopt Reed Solomon coding and Convolutional coding are discussed and validated with experiment.The difference of data transmission channel coding among FY-3,METOP and NPP/NPOESS are discussed,and so on.

title: Coordiante Varied Texts in Six Classics and Integrate Different Schools of Thought——A Tentative Thesis on Sima Qian′s Academic Thought of Intergation
abstract: Sima Qian's academic ideas should not be simply analyzed in Confucian or Taolist standard.He compromised the essentials of six classics and their interpretations and sumed up all schools of ideas before the West Han dynasty without any discrimination.He inherited and developed his father's(Sima Tan)spirit of academic freedom and independent thinking and undertook the academic integrity to the previous academic ideas different from Dong Zhongshu and Ban Gu and attained the highest level of his time.\;

title: Relations of Trade and Investment between China and India since 1990s
abstract: The bilateral trade and investment between China and India continue to expand with the improvement of political relations since 1990s. However,there is also a small proportion of trade and investment,trade imbalance and frequent trade frictions issues between China and India. Therefore,we must analyze the status and issues of trade and investment of Sino-India,and explore the development trends and prospects so as to further promote the overall development of relations of trade and investment between China and India.

title: Analysis of the acceleration responsivity of an air-backed mandrel fiber-optic hydrophone
abstract: The acceleration responsivity is a significant parameter for a fiber-optic hydro- phone used in underwater acoustic detection.In this paper,the axial acceleration respons- ivity of an air-backed mandrel fiber-optic hydrophone is investigated by using the finite ele- ment method(FEM),and compared with some experiment result.Some analysis results are given:Increasing the rigidity of mandrel can decrease the acceleration responsivity of the fiber-optic hydrophone and changing the thickness of mandrel has little affect on the ac- celeration responsivity.

title: Application of Cement Deep Mixing Method to Ultrasoft Harbor Foundation Improvement
abstract: The cement deep mixing method was applied to improve an ultrasoft harbor foundation, the bearing capacity of foundation was 80~90 kPa, and that of part of foundation was less than 60 kPa. It is shown from in situ test that the pile shaft strength at the age of 90 days is greater than 1.80 MPa, the single pile's bearing capacity is greater than 150 kN, and the composite foundation standard bearing eapacity for two pile layout schemes is greater than the design specifications (230 kPa). It is shown from the test results that the cement deep mixing method with appropriate construction technology can increase the foundation bearing capacity by 2 to 3.5 times and save a great deal of project investiment.

title: Thermodynamic coupling theory and substitution effect of the simultaneous reaction of palladium with H_2, D_2 and CO
abstract: The structures and energy of PdCO, PdH, and PdD were optimized by using the density functional method (B3P86) with the relativistic effective core potential (RECP) basis sets SDD for Pd and 6- 311+ +G~(**) for H (D) and C, O. The reaction equilibrium constants and equilibrium pressures of Pd with H_2,Pd with D_2 and Pd with CO were calculated by means of the approximate theory of electron-vibration motion, respectively. And the reaction equilibrium component and the equilibrium pressures of Pd with H_2, D_2 and CO simultaneously were computed. Then the substitution effect and the coupling competition effect were investigated.

title: Study of Selection with 8-methoxy-psoralen in Streptomyces lavendulae
abstract: The paper reported first the results of study about the interaction between 8-methoxy-psoralen and Streptomyces lavendulae, and application of 8-Mop in breeding of Streptomyces lavendulae. The high-producing strain increased the unit of fermentation about 18.3% than control, It has been applied in China.

title: Properties and Preparation of the Copolymer Resin of Allylic COPNA Resin and BMI
abstract: The condensed polynuclear aromatic(COPNA) resin was synthesized using 1-naphthol as monomer and 1,4-benzenedimethanol as crossing-linking agent in the presence of p-toluene sulfonic acid,and then allylated to prepare the allylic COPNA resin having the copolymerization reactivity with 4,4'-bismaleimidodiphenyl methane(BMI) to obtain high performance resin.Properties and preparation of the copolymer resin of allylic COPNA resin and BMI were studied in this paper.The chemical structures and rheological properties of the prepolymer were characterized by FT-IR and viscometer,respectively.The curing reaction of the prepolymer was studied by DSC.Moreover,TG-DTG was employed to study the thermal behavior of the copolymer resin.The results show that the prepolymer has good rheological properties and can be easily controlled during the curing reaction.Furthermore,the cured copolymer resin has good thermo-stability,as indicated by that its initial decomposition temperature arrives at 450 ℃ and the carbon yield reaches 53.6% at 800 ℃ in nitrogen.

title: The Research of Building the Belt of Professional Sports Culture in Northeast Asia
abstract: The Northeast Asia area is the most important area in economic development and the key of becoming the global nation for our country.At same time,There have the most developed region in Asian sports,but in the area,there actually does not have a stable athletic exchange mechanism.Carries out the integration in professional sports will promote the social interaction,to mutually trust and the use maximization for sports resources.In fact,there are same cultural base,quickly economic development and the Frequent contact in sports culture,then provided the development foundation for the professional sports integration among the countries in Northeast Asia.

title: Analysis on Environmental Air Quality in Mudanjiang City
abstract: The causes and changing trends of environmental air pollution in Mudanjiang city were discussed,and the trends analysis were carried out by Spearman correlation coefficients method.The results showed that environmental air pollutants mainly constructed with PM10 and dust in Mudanjiang city,which showed the trend of decreasing.Some countermeasures were put forward to improve the local environmental air quality.

title: Grey relational analysis of fracture parameters of concrete
abstract: According to the fact that there are few experimental data of concrete fracture which can not be analyzed by traditional statistical method,grey relational analysis is introduced into the analysis of fracture parameters of three-point bending beams and large CT-specimens.Relationship among all variables obtained from experiments is investigated,whose reasons are discussed.Results suggest that fracture intensity and fracture energy of three-point bending beams are size-dependent and fracture parameters of CT-specimens are size-independent,which offers a new approach to fracture analysis of concrete.

title: Catalytic Property of CuO-CeO_2 Catalyst for CO Selective Oxidation in H_2-Rich Streams
abstract: Cordierite granule with higher surface has been obtained by boiled in oxalic acid.The effect of treatment time on the carrier loss,the mechanical intensity and the surface area was analyzed.CuO-CeO_2 was coated on the cordierite carrier by soaking.Gas chromatography was used to test the catalytic property of CuO-CeO_2/cord catalyst.Results showed when 15%(weight ratio)CuO-CeO_2 was coated on the cordierite,treated 2 h in oxalic acid,the CuO-CeO_2/cord catalyst exhibited a better catalytic activity and selectivity for CO selective oxidation in H_2-rich streams.

title: Characteristics of Fiber Hydrophyones and its Research Situation
abstract: The principles,applications and control techniques of Fiber Hydrophones have been introduced,and the reseacher situations of Fiber Hydrophones have been discussed too,it is benefit to know the Fiber Hydrophones and its development.

title: The Morphological Sorting of Intercavernous Sinuses and its Clinical Significance
abstract: Objective:To provide anatomic data for transnasal tumorectomy hypophysoma and extended transnasal surgery,avoiding injury of cavernous sinuses and decreasing complication after operation. Methods:The positions and shapes of cavernous sinuses were observed and sorted on 20 adult cadavers (12 males,8 females) under microscope. Results:Based on the position relation between the sinus intercavernosus anterior and pituitary gland,the intercavernous sinuses were classified into three types,namely,typeⅠ,Ⅱ and Ⅲ,which accounted for 55%(11/20),30%(6/20) and 15%(3/20),respectively. However,based on the radius vectors of inferior intercavernous sinuses,the proportion of typeⅠ,Ⅱand Ⅲ were 15%(3/20);80%(16/20) and 5%(1/20),respectively. Conclusion:It is very important that the operator is familiar with the shapes and types of intercavernous sinuses to avoid bleeding during the operations in sella region via transnasal approach.

title: DYNAMICAL CHARACTERISTICS OF DOUBLE POROSITY/DOUBLE PERMEABILITY MODEL INCLUDING THE EFFECT OF QUADRATIC GRADIENT TERM
abstract: Traditional well-test models for flow are not consistent with the material balance equation. According to the assumption of slightly compressible fluid, the quadratic gradient term in the nonlinear partial differential equation is usually neglected. It is known that neglecting the quadratic gradient term results in errors for large time well-test. A method which is consistent with the material balance equation for fractured reservoir with double porosity/double permeability is proposed. All terms in the nonlinear partial differential equation are retained. Double porosity/double permeability models are given. The numerical solutions of double porosity/double permeability models are obtained by the Douglas-Jones predictor-corrector method at a constant rate and the constant-pressure production for an infinitely large system. It also deals with the change rule of pressure while fluid compressibility and double porosity parameters change. Plots of the typical pressure curves are given, and the results can be applied to the well-test analysis.

title: STUDY ON THE MODIFICATION OF COAL TAR PITCH FOR CARBON PRECURESOR
abstract: Modification of coal tar pitch as a carbon precursor was studied using divinylbenzene (DVB) as a cross linking agent by the aid of acid catalyst. The microstructure and thermostability of modified coal tar pitch had been studied. It was indicated that the modified coal pitch, which had not only a great deal of mesophase microbead but good thermostability as well, can be qualified to be an excellent carbon precursor.

title: Null Controllability of Semilinear Parabolic Equation With Nonlinear Terms Involving a Maximal Monotone Graph
abstract: This work concerns the null controllability of the system governed by semilinear parabolic equation with nonlinearity involving a bounded maximal monotone graph. We obtain by the Kakutani's fixed point theorem and the associated controllability for linear parabolic equations that the system is null controllable in the case when control acts in a subdomain. As a consequence, we also obtain that the system is null controllable when control acts on a portion of the boundary.

title: NONLINEAR TIME-DOMAIN OPTIMIZATION OF TWO-DIMENSIONAL LOSSLESS DIELECTRIC INHOMOGENEITY PROFILE RECONSTRUCTION
abstract: The Born iterative method is used to solve the nonlinear inverse scattering problem for two-dimensional dielectrie inhomogeneity using timedomain data; three order difference regularization is applied to improve the inversion process; and a general selecting regularization parameter is developed.

title: On Legal Issues of Security and Protection Management for the Large -scale Activities
abstract: At present,there are shortcomings of security problems existing in law system for the large mass activities,mainly as: the low law level,the less responsibility,the vague-defined provisions contents,and the poor implementation effect and so on.This paper suggests that we should improve the law level,strengthen the law force to the responsibility,let law prevention play a role,clear define standards of the large-scale activities,strengthen the supervision and management of contractors;enhance the law enforcement in every way,etc.as the result in the improvement of the current law system.

title: COMPUTATION AND EXPERIMENT OF LINEAR MAGNETO-HYDRODYNAMIC PROPULSOR
abstract: To predict the flow and electric field inside the MHD channel and to gain a thorough understanding of the performance inside the propulsion system, a two-dimensional mathematical model for a direct current, linear channel MHD propulsion system is presented in this paper. By FEM method, the flow and current distributions at the MHD drive section are analyzed, and propulsive force is gained. By comparing with the data of experiment, the correctness of the computation program is validated.

title: A NOVEL METHOD FOR MICROWAVE IMAG1NG OF TW0-DIMENSIONAL TARGETS
abstract: The microwave imaging of two dimensional targets is discussed in this paper.By volume equivalence principle, a system of integral equations is obtained. They link the media's permittivity and conductivity with scattering field and total field. Then, the inversion equation is obtained after taking variation on these integral equations. Some properties including the converging speed, inversion accuracy and its ability to inverse complex targets are investigated. The effect of random noise is also discussed in this pa-per.

title: College Students' Lack of Honesty and Credibility and Reconstruction
abstract: On the basis of the concept that honesty and credibility is Chinese traditional morality, this paper points out the behaviors of college students' lack of honesty and credibility at present, analyses the causes and puts forward four measures to reconstruct college students' honesty and credibility , which are to strengthen the example mechanism in the society, to amend the supervise mechanism of regulations, to reinforce the guide of education, and to strengthen mechanism of the individual self - consciousness.

title: Numeric Simulation of Flow Field Inside a Composite Fan Impeller
abstract: With viscious fluid mechanics basic theory and CFD software,numeric simulation of air flow inside a composite fan impeller was made,and that air flow inside fan impeller was not good was found,so blades of the impeller were optimized to result in a better air flow and better aerodynamic properties,and to lay a good foundation for developing high performance new composite fan impeller.

title: On the Reasonable Exploitation and Scientific Management of College Personnel Resources
abstract: The 21st century is an era of knowledge economy with the establishment of China's market economic system and the implementation of the strateges of educational industrialization,how to reasonably exploit college personnel resources and scientifically manage colleges is an important subject for the college development. The article analysizes the inner laws of the current situation and the characteristics of colleges and universities' personnel resources, and puts forward some suggestions for the reasonable development and efficient management.

title: Correlation between human papilloma virus and Chlamydia trachomatis infection in female genitourinary tract
abstract: Objective To analyze the relationship between human papilloma virus(HPV) and chlamydia trachomatis(CT) infection in female genitourinary tract.Methods 348 female patients were enrolled and detected for HPV DNA and CT DNA in cervical exfoliated cell specimens,and the results were statistically analyzed.Results The total positive rates of HPV DNA and CT DNA were 13.2%(46/348) and 9.2%(32/348) respectively.The positive rates of CT DNA in HPV DNA positive and negative patients were 23.9%(11/46) and 7.0%(21/302),which were with statistical difference(P0.05).Conclusion There might be correlation between female genitourinary infection of HPV and CT.

title: Self-adjustment of cortrolparameters by Fuzzy-PID controller
abstract: In order to expand tranditional PID control, on the basis of analysis for Fuzzy and PID control principle, an effective structure of conjunct controller by the conjugation with Fuzzy and PID controller was obtained. Some Key issues in the design of Fuzzy controller was introduced. Connected Fuzzy Tool Box in MATLAB with SIMULINK by Readfis command, the simulation of three typical objects was realized. Results show that the step responses of simulation examplification are close to ideal ones, so that the process of design and debuging can be made easier for practical control system.

title: Variation of oxygen free radicals after apoptosis induced by cisplatin in human cervical cancer Hela cells
abstract: Objective To study the variation of the intracellular oxygen free radicals after apoptosis induced by cisplatin in human cervical carcinoma cells.Methods Human cervical cancer cell line(Hela) were treated with different concentrations of DDP. The activation of the cell line,the changes in cell cycle,and the morphological changes of apoptosis cells were detected by MTT colorimetric assay,flow cytometry and electron microscopy,and the contents of intracellular malondialdehyde(MDA),superoxide dismutase (SOD) and glutathione(GSH) were detected by chemical colorimetric method.Results According to the MTT,the IC_(50) of DDP was 3 mg/L at the 48 h point,and DDP had no significant cytoxicity on Hela cell line when its concentration was less than 3 mg/L;contrarily, the effects were dose-dependent when the concentration of DDP was higher than 3 mg/L(P0.001).Compared with control group,the percentage of G2 phase cells increased(90.80±8.37)%in Hela+DDP group,while the number of G1 and S phase cells decreased significantly,the values were(30.84±8.02,5.30±0.60)%,and(P0.01),respectively.The typical morphological changes of the early apoptotic cells could be observed by scanning and transmission electron microscopy.Compared with the control group,the activities of SOD and GSH decreased significantly(P0.05) at the 48 hours point in the DDP group,and the concentration of MDA increased remarkably(P0.01).Conclusions DDP induces the death of Hela cells;the mechanism may be related to the oxidative damage in cells.

title: Study on the best mixed proportion and iodoform additive proportion of root canal sealing paste
abstract: AIM:To observe the affect of different mixed proportion and iodoform additive proportion to the sealing ability of root canal sealing paste in vitro .METHODS:The capillary glass tubes was used in the dye-penetration test.RESULTS:Accompanied by increment of mixed proportion (powder to liquid), the difficulty of filling glass tubes obviously raised,but the degree of dye penetration was obviously decreased. In addition,accompanied by increment of iodoform additive proportion, not only the volume of root canal sealing paste obviously shrank, but the degrees of dye penetration was obviously increased.CONCLUSION:2.5∶1(powder to liquid) is the best mixed proportion of root canal sealing paste.1∶5 is the proper additive proportion of iodoform in root canal sealing paste.

title: The Exploration of the Multi Cooperation All Win Mode of Urban Renewal: The Mode and Revelation of New Roppongi
abstract: The urban renewal has already become the main form of urbanization in our country, however, a lot of problems have broke in the transformation process of old city residential areas. This article analyzes the necessity of urban renewal and dissects the challenges and opportunities of our urban renewal. Through analyzing the features, experiences and lessons of old city reconstruction of Roppongi in Japan,it proposes a Multi Cooperation All Win Mode with the government、developers and resident by analyzing the advantages and lessons of the reconstruct of Roppongi and relating to China's national conditions, and then discourses its feasibility.

title: Fault Analysis and Prevention Measure of Lightning for Electrified Open Operation Circuit Breaker
abstract: According to the switch burn out accident occurred after lightning over voltage in two substations in Quzhou Electric Power Bureau, the damage of electrified and open operation switch due to lightning over voltage was analyzed from the principles of reflection and refraction of over voltage. The major reason is that the total reflective over voltage occurred at the end of open circuit to cause over voltage substantially. The paper puts forward corresponding improvement and protective measures.

title: Research on CEO Supervise System
abstract: To inspire and restrict CEO is an important problem in modern economics. How the boards of directors supervise the CEO was discussed in the paper. As exterior director and interior director have different risk utility, the intending to monitor is different. The difference of intending of monitor was showed and the relationship of monitor and director's utility was given. The option value of manager wage was analyzed by using the option equation of Black Scholes.

title: Clinical study of joint mobilization in treating the post-stroke shoulder hand syndrome
abstract: Objectives To study the efficacy of joint mobilization in treatment of the post-stroke shoulder and hand syndrome. Methods Thirty-eight post-stroke hemiplegic patients who had the shoulder pain syndrome and were diagnosed as having reflex sympathetic dystrophy(RSD)were classified into two groups randomly,19 in each.The trial group was treated with by joint mobilization besides common physical therapies,and the control group was treated by conventional physical therapy alone.Each patient was evaluated for global perceived effect(GPE),visual analog scale(VAS)and shoulder joint range of motion(ROM)scale.The CHIS statistical software was used.Results The improvement of symptoms in the trial group was more pronounced than that in the control group statistically,and so was in both groups,as compared with before.Conclusions Joint mobilization relieves pain and improves the sympathetic system,both of which may be the key factors of inducing RSD.

title: Research on CAD system of molds
abstract: The present state and development tendency of mold CAD are introduced and the technical basis of its development, features and requirement of mold CAD system are discussed in detail, and some softwares of mold CAD are brielfly introduced, also.

title: Improvement of super deep and soft ground under embankment of expressway with combination method of vacuum and preloading
abstract: The embankment of an expressway is constructed by material whose anti deformation ability is very bad, and its fill height is larger than 6 m. The ground contains a muddy clay with thickness of 20 m and water content of 43%~70%. For the stability and settlement of embankment, combination method of vacuum and preloading is adaped to improve the foundation. It is indicated that the improvement effect is very obvious. Compared with preloading, the period of construction can be decrease halfly, the settlement of roadbed reduced 10%. The strength of soil is increased by more than 2 times. The consolidation degree of soil is larger than 95% after the embankment of height of 6.7 m is filled and vacuum preloading is constructed for 2 months. The displacement of foundation soil is smaller than 1.0 mm/d during the construction of embankment, and the embankment and ground soil is stable. The settlement of roadbed is smaller than 20 cm during the operation. The experience can be referenced to the other and similar engineerings.

title: The study of the relationship between cervical cancer and the infection of HPV, the expression of CD44v7/8
abstract: Objective: We investgate the roli that the infection of HPV, the expression of CD44v7/8 has played in the utrine cervix by researching their relationship between them. Methods:The infection of HPV,the expression of CD44v7/8 in 59 cases with cervical cancer, 18 cases chronic cervicitis and 18 cases with ondyloma acuminatum were deleted by means of hybridization in stitu and in mmunohistochemical method, respectively. Results: The percentage of cases with expression of HPVin cervical cancer, condyloma acuminatun, and chronic cervicitis was 59.32%, 61.11% and 11.11%, respectively. The positive percentage with expression of HPVin cervical cancer and condyloma acuminatum was higher than that in chronic cervicitis, there was statistical significance. The positive rate with expression of HPV insquamous cell carcinoma of cervix and adenocarcinoma of cervix was 63. 04% and 53. 85% , respectively. There was no statistical difference between them. The positive rate with expression of CD44v7/ 8 protein in there kinds of diseases was 76. 27%,11.11% and 11.11%, respectively. It was more higher in cervical cancer than that in chronic cervicitis and condyloma acuminatum with statistical difference. Conclusion: Infection of HPV was one of the causes of cervical cancer. Prevention of HPV infection has acrucial signifivance in reducing morbidty rate of cervical cancer. The expression up-regulation of CD44v7/8 protein has something to do with genesis of cervical cancer.

title: Design of car radio module based on TEF6606 chip
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the application of TEF6606 chip in car radio.According to the characteristics of automotive power supply,a reasonable circuit is designed,so the lower power consumption can be achieved in power-saving mode.The MCU control the corresponding registers of TEF6606 chip by the PC bus to implement the digital tuned stereo radio.And in order to meet the different requirements,the diversification of tuning function,such as audio-search and scampering modes,can be realized by programming.

title: On System Analysis of Rural Poverty
abstract: China's peasants who have noticeably increased, but gradually the gap between the incomes of urban and rural residents widened. Depth analysis of the causes of poor peasants and corresponding countermeasures before us is a pressing issue. From this perspective, I think the system, caused the current situation of Chinese peasants poverty is the main reason for a lack of effective systems, The way to solve the poverty problem in the design of the system also is reasonable.

title: BMI/Montmorillonite Nanocomposites(II)──Preparation and Characterzation of the Nanocomposites
abstract: Preparation and characterization of bismaleimides(BMI)/montmorillonite(MMT)nanocomposites was investigated in this paper.Na-montmorillonite was modified with allyl-tri-phenyl phosphonium bromide(AP)by cation-exchange method to obtain organic MMT(OMMT),and diallylbisphenol A was used as modifier for BMI resin.The nanocomposites were prepared via in situ polymerization,and the properties of the nanocomposites were characterized by FT-IR、WAXD、TEM、TGA.The results show that AP reacts with BMI to form covalent bond due to the active group of allyl,favoring high interfacial bonding performance between MMT and matrix resin.The exfoliated nanocomposites can be obtained,due to the relatively complete intercalation of matrix resin to the OMMT when the OMMT content is kept low.Moreover,the thermal stability of the nanocomposites is improved,the initial decomposition temperature of which increases from 418.2 ℃ to 439.6 ℃.

title: Research on Mobilizing the Post-nineties Generation for Promoting Construction of Campus Culture
abstract: Campus culture is historical accumulation of a university in long-term development process,which has deeply influenced lots of student's morals,behavior,and life style.On the contrary,development and construction of campus culture are promoted by students group which play an important role in it.Both can complement and promote each other in developing.The generation after 90s has their own special way of thinking and value tendency.As the main force of the campus culture construction,how to arouse their enthusiasm for injecting new vitality to campus culture is the key to the development of campus culture in new period.

title: Discussion about the Project Management
abstract: This paper analyses the basic ideas of construction project management,and the project item of construction. The paper points out the relation and differents in the project management,construction supervision,design and construction management.

title: The Origin of Civilization in China with the Observation of Celestial Phenomena and Calender Making——On the formation of political authority during the initial period of state from Tao Si relic of observing celestial phenomena and offering sacri
abstract: According to our present common knowledge, the most important thing for a government is , at any rate, not such a thing as observing celestial phenomena and drawing up calendar no matter how many vital things it has to deal with, such as the national and military affairs, the national security, the national economy and the people 's livelihood, etc. However, as is recorded in Yao Dian, the most important state affair was to send officials to observe celestial phenomena and draw up calendar, which has been much easier to understand through the archaeological discoveries in Tao si, the biggest single building of Tao Si culture up to now with the function of observing celestial phenomena and offering sacrifices to gods or ancestors. Through the connection of the two, we may infer that there was a special characteristic among the earliest states in China, that is, observing celestial phenomena and drawing up calendar so as to promulgate it .

title: The Age of Knowledge and Economy & the Training of Creative Talent ——A Study of the Theory for Teaching Reforms of Chemical Specialty
abstract: On the basis of research and practice teaching reforms of chemical specialty,the demands of personal training for the age of knowledge based economy was theoretically expounded in intellectual economic age.The authors point out that the cultivation of creative talent is the central task of higher education.In addition,the major characteristics of creative telent and,and the way how to cultivate creative talent are discussed.

title: Based on Reality and Laws to Contruct Excellent Enterprise
abstract: From the view of leading group construction,cultivating enterprise culture,pushing rulereform and opening,some measures of enterprise management and their effect are expounded.

title: The Primary Research on the Training Ways of the Short-running Athletes' Breakthrough of Speed
abstract: To point out obstacle that the short-running athletes have in the practice of speed and the solutions to the problems and check on the effective of training method with statistics.

title: Design and implementation of a real-time monitoring system for a detection network of large-sized automatic weather stations
abstract: A design method of windows based monitoring software using the VB6.0 language and an intellective multi functional MODEM with the microprocessor 80C320 as the core and with the C51 programming language is presented. The basic compositions and implementation ideas are also discussed. With the X.25 communication technique, the system is able to have real time monitoring of a detection network of large sized automatic weather stations.

title: Fostering the Higher Professional Students' Quality of Starting Undertaking
abstract: It's a new question for study of higher professional school that the students' quality should be fostered in four aspects including the consciousness of start undertaking, the psychological quality of start undertaking, the ability of start undertaking and the knowledge of start undertaking. It's the responsibility, the mission and the core of the higher professional education to strengthen the cultivation of the higher professional students at the time of the knowledge-based economy age.

title: A SELF-ORGANIZING NEURAL NETWORK FOR PARTITIONING ON MCM
abstract: In this paper,a method of expression for similarity relationship between blocks connected directly or indirectly is proposed, then a new approach, based on the self-organizing feature mapping neural network, for partitioning on MCM, is presented. The algorithm considers the problem of assigning functional blocks into slots on Multi-Chip Modules during high level design in order to have fast feedback on the impact of high level design decisions. The method is considering both similarity relationship between blocks and physical structure of MCM; having double optimal object, minimizing number of connections between chips and cycle time of system; making connections occur between chips as closer as possible; satisfying area constraints and thermal constraints. In addition,on basis of the hierarchical neural network model,this paper proposes a hierarchical neural learning algorithm for partitioning on MCM under capacity constraints. The neural network has reasonable structure and rapid training speed.

title: Study on Polyurethane Adhesive for Aluminium-Resin Composite Boards
abstract: The method of making polyurethane adhesive used in manufacturing Aluminium-resin composite boards is introduced and the effects of formula,reaction temperature,water content and NCO/OH ratio upon adhesive properties and peel strength are discussed.

title: CT and MRI Diagnosis of Cystic Brain Metastases
abstract: Objective To study the CT and MRI features of cystic brain metastases. Methods 26 cases of cystic brain metastases proved by clinicopathology were presented.There were13 males and 13 females with an average age of 52.7 years.CT studies were obtained in 15 cases,while MR studies were done in 13 cases.11 cases had CT and/or MRI contrast enhancement studies. Results According to the shape of the wall of cystic brain metastases,48 tumors in 26 cases were classified into three types: irregular,nodular,regular type.The wall demonstrated iso-or slightly high density on CT and iso-or slightly low intensity on MR T_1WI and T_2WI,while the hydatid fluid showed slightly high intensity on MR T_1WI and high intensity on T_2WI and iso-or slightly high density on CT compared to CSF.The tumors showed circular reinforcement on enhanced CT or MRI,with nodular enhancement in some cases. Conclusion Cystic brain metastases have mutiple types and should be differentiated from brain abcess and other cystic brain parenchamal tumors.Multi-direction enhanced MRI is helpful to diagnosis.

title: Education Management Major on Line for Centralized Practice Training in Open and Distance Learning
abstract: The practice teaching in open education refers student acquisition of perceptual knowledge and basic skills and their improvement of the overall quality of a series of teaching activities in open and distance learning under the guidance of their teachers.The centralized practice teaching in the open and distance learning not only focuses on professional capacity-building,but also focuses on the capacity-building of theory and practice,and more importantly,on student self-learning ability and the training of their overall quality as well as the training of their continuous learning ability to adapt themselves to social development in the modern educational technology.The paper deals with the difficulties in the centralized practice teaching in the open and distance learning and combines the specific issues in the centralized practice teaching in the open education in Yunnan RTV University and proposes some personal viewpoints by the in-depth analysis of the problems and causes in the current practice teaching.

title: Application and Abnormal Data Processing from Systematic Well Test of Gas Well
abstract: A method for simultaneous-solution of one-point binomial is established for using the abnormal data or curves from systematic well test of gas well to evaluate the productivity and inflow performance of multilayer gas pool and reasonably classify the layer series of development. The uniquely indicative curve and unique curve of inflow performance curve from each layer in gas well are based on the processing of these abnormal well test data. Also, the productivity, interlayer interference and corresponding processes of selective zone production and full zone production are analyzed and applied to the case study. The results show that this method can be used for quanti- tatively evaluating the interference of multilayer gas pool, thus determining the rational production or recovery process.

title: Polymorphism of two microsatellites PAX3 And D2S401 closely linked with COL4A3/COL4A4 of gene in chromosome 2
abstract: Objective To study the polymorphism of two microsatellites PAX3 and D2S401 closely linked with COL4A3/COL4A4 gene in chromosome 2.Methods The two microsatellite markers PAX3 and D2S401 were amplified by polymerase chain reaction,followed by 10% non-denatured polyacrylamide gel electrophresis. Results Five PAX3 alleles and six D2S401 alleles were observed in 60 Chinese Han people. The polymorphism information content (PIC) values of them were 0. 66 and 0. 76, respectively. Conclution PAX3 and D2S401 are highly polymorphic and can be used in the gene linked analysis.

title: An Efficient Micropayment System Based on Hash Chain
abstract: In this paper, we propose an off-line, prepaid micropayment system based on hash chain, which supports transferability of digital coins in a simpler way. Moreover, in our system, a hash chain remaining unspent can be transferred by one user to the other and the profits of both consumers and merchants are protected, so the fairness of our system is high. Compared with other micropayment schemes, e.g. PayWord, no public-key operation is required, which improves the efficiency of our system. In addition, restricted anonymity is provided in our system.

title: Cloning ofα-Hydroxynitrile Lyase Gene from Cassava and Construction of its Expression Vector
abstract: Objective To study the cloning of the cDNA ofα-HNL and the expression vector construction to realize highly efficient expression in NL gene.Methods The long-length sequence of cDNA ofα-HNL was amplified by RT-PCR,then it was cloned into pBlueseript SK and analylizd in its sequence.Finall,the cDNA was cloned into an expression vector pPIC3.5K by PCR.Re- sults The sequencing result of the cDNA showed that the sequence encoded for the HNL was not fully consistent with those pub- lished.The full sequences analysis demonstrated that the highest homology of cDNA sequence is about 99.1% and the highest ho- mology of amino acid sequence is about 98.8% to those four reported HNL genes from cassava.Conculsion Degestion detection of pPIC3.5K- HNL showed that construction of recombination expression vector was successful.

title: Keyboard design based on ergonomics
abstract: The ergonomical design of the desktop computer keyboard was discussed in the paper.From the point of view of plane layout,keystroke match of the central section,edit localization section and number aided section,the color design,the keyboard was improved pleasurably.The efficiency of the new keyboard processing is better.

title: Status quo and Countermeasures of Medical Equipment in Use and Maintenance
abstract: This paper expatiates and analyzes the various problems in the course of using and maintaining the medical equipment in hospital.It also puts forward some substantive countermeasures to solve the problems such as training for operators,setting of management regulations,broadening the position and team construction of qualified personnel in medical engineering,etc.

title: Speedy Fault Information Management System for Urban Grid Based on Field Bus
abstract: Aiming at problem of urban grid management difficulty,such as many locations,complex structure and many facilities,a speedy fault information management system for urban substation based on field bus and Ethernet was introduced.The actuality of fault management and feasibility of new scheme were analyzed.The design and function of new fault information management system were proposed.The system can improve real time and efficient for power grid distribution management.

title: Electroless Copper Plating Technology for Tungsten Powder
abstract: Tungsten powder is a kind of higher density material and hard to process, plating copper can improve its processing performance. Electroless copper plating on the tungsten powder was introduced that plating bath was composed of copper sulfate (CuSO_4), Na_2EDTA, formaldehyde (HCHO) with pH value 11～13, and plating temperature was 70 ℃. The bath was strongly stirred with an electromotive stirrer. Choice of reducer, contents of ingredients and effect of passivant were also studied. Results show that formaldehyde is an ideal reducer, and 3N benzotriazole has better passivation effect on copper plating. The technology can achieve copper plating on 500 g tungsten powder at a time, and the surface color of copper plated tungsten powder will no change for a long time laying, which can meet the needs of tungsten powder processing.

title: Experimental Research of Mode II Fracture Based on Self-monitoring Behavior of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Concrete
abstract: Because it is difficult to determine fracture toughness of pure mode Ⅱ fracture,the self-monitoring behavior of carbon fiber reinforced concrete was used to investigate mode Ⅱfracture of double edge notched specimen.The results show that resistance increases with increase of load and displacement,which shows relationship like Lorentz curve.Self-monitoring behavior of carbon fiber reinforced concrete can be used to ascertain K_(ⅡC)values of double edge notched specimen,which are found to be higher than that of normal strength concrete.The curves of fractional change in resistance before maximum load can illustrate three stages,that is,such as elastic deformation,stable fracture and unstable fracture.

title: The study of building college to the b ase of track -and -field in china
abstract: track -and -field is the most item in modern Olympic games,and the base of developing athletics level of the country.How to develop a thletics level is the key of insuring the level of athletics in our country to breakthrough .Along with the establ ish consummate and consummate of socialism market economy ,the environ-ment of economy development in China has been changed.Intrinsic trainin g system already can' t adapt the current society.combining to literature an d investigation and the experience o verseas,this article try to find the superiority and question in existence ,and table the proposal of building athletics t eam and elevating the level of track -and -field.

title: From Human--Centrism to Sustainable Development——An Essential Improvement of Human Ethical ideas
